chapter.verse: Ei a thahatte, eimaumah nuamsa khop lo-in a thanemte' zawngkhalna thuakpih ding vaipuak i nei hi.
Eite khat ciat in i vengte a lambeh i hih nadingin amaute' phattuam ding enin lungkimsak ciat ni.
Khris zong ama' ut bangin gamta lo-in, “Nang hong simmawhte' hong simmawhna teng kei' tungah hong tu hi,” ci-in a kigelh mah bangin simmawhna na thuak hi.
A hang pen a kigelh ngei khempeuh eite' ading hilhcianna ahi dingin a kigelh hi a, thuakzawhna tungtawnin leh Pasian' Laibupi ii thapiakna tungtawnin lametna i neih theih nading ahi hi.
Thuakzawhna leh thapiakna Pasian in Khris Jesu' zia tawh kituakin khatlekhat kithuhualna hong guan henla
lawng khatin ginna tawh i Topa Jesu Khris ii Pa leh Pasian a phatkhawmte hong hisak ta hen.
Tua hi a, Khris in note hong san mah bangin Pasian' minpha a kilat nadingin khatlekhat na kisang un.
A hang pen note kong genin ah Khris pen Pasian' thumaan thutak a lak dingin vun-at mite' kiangah nasem khat va suak a, tua pen pupite' tunga kipia kamciamte a kipsak nading leh

Pasian a thukhualna hangin Gentile mite in zong ama' minpha a kilatsak theih nading ahi hi. A nuai-a lai kigelh bang ahi hi: “Tua ahih manin Gentile mite' lakah nang kong phat ding a, nangma' min pahtawina la ka sa ding hi.”
Hih bangin zong kigen hi: “Gentile mite aw, ama' mipawl tawh lungdam un.”
Khat om lai hi: “No Gentile mi khempeuh aw, Topa phat un; minam khempeuh in zong phat uh hen.”
Isaiah in zong hici gen hi: “Jesse' zung hong mengkhia ding a, Gentile mite a uk dingin a hong khang mipa; Gentile mite in amah lamen ding uh hi.”
Kha Siangtho' vangliatna tawh lametna a dimlet na neih nadingun lametna Pasian in upna sungah nakpi nuamna leh nopna lemna hong dip ta hen.
Sanggamte aw, note pen lungsim hoih tawh kidim, thutheihna a namkim tawh zong kidim, khatlekhat zong kitaaibawl thei ci-in kong um kong muang hi.
Ahi zongin phawksakna namin vai kimkhat hangtak kong gelh hi. Tua pen Pasian' hong piak hehpihna a suang ka hi hi.

A hang pen Gentile mite' biakpiak vante Kha Siangtho' siansuahna tawh a santaak a suah theih nadingin tua hehpihna hangin Gentile mite' kianga Pasian' Lungdamna Thu a tangko siampi nasepna sungah Khris Jesu' nasem ka hih man hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian tawh kisai thu ah Khris Jesu' hangin ka kisathei hi.
A hang pen kei' tungtawnin Khris' zawhsiang khitsa nasep, Gentile mite Pasian' thu sung ka tunpihna thu losiah thudang ka gen ngam kei ding hi. Tua nasep hong zosak pen thugenna leh sepkhiatna,
kihilna lim lamdangte' thakhauhna, Pasian' Kha Siangtho' vangliatna, cihte hi a, hih teng hangin Jerusalem pan Illyricum dong nangawn Khris' Lungdamna Thu tangkona a cin khinta ka hi hi.
Tua hi a, ka lungtuppi ahihleh midang khat' phuhsa khuambul tungah a lambeh ka hihkhak loh nadingin Khris a kitheih nailohna munte bek ah Lungdamna Thu tangko ding, cih hi.
A nuai-a lai kigelh bang mah ahi hi: “Ama' thu a kigen ngei nailohna mite in mu ding uh a, tua thu a za ngei nailo mite in theitel ding uh hi.”
Note' kiangah kong pai ding a kipelh pahpahna zong hih thu hang mah ahi hi.
Tu-in ahihleh hih gamte ah vai nei nawnlo ka hih manin leh note' kiangah kong painop zong kum tampi pha khin ahih manin
Spain ka pai ciangin kong nawk kawmin note tawh kimuh ding leh tawmvei sung nuamtak i kikholh khit ciangin tua taka ka khualzinna ah note' huhna ngah ding cih ka lamen hi.
Himah taleh tu tadihin mi siangthote' ading huhna puak dingin Jerusalem a pai ding ka hi hi.
A hang pen Macedonia-te leh Achaia-te in Jerusalem khua mi siangthote laka a cimawhte' tungah panpihna pawlkhat neih ding hoih sa uh hi.

Tua banga huh ding pen amaute lungkim uh a, tua bang dingin zong lungdam leiba a nei taktak uh ahi hi. A hang pen Gentile-te in kha thu ah Jew mite' ngah teng ngahkha khin uh ahihleh leitung vanlena thu ah zong Jew mite panpih ding leiba a nei uh ahi hi.
Tua hi a, hih vai ka man khit, hih a kingahsa teng amau' kiang tung dingin ciaptehna gip ka belh khit ciangin note' omna lam tawnin Spain ka manawh ding hi.
Kong tun ciangin Khris' thupha bucing tawh hong tung ding ka hihlam ka kithei hi.
Sanggamte aw, i Topa Jesu Khris' min leh Kha Siangtho' itna suangin kong thumnop ah kei' taangin Pasian' kianga na thungetnate uhah kei tawh hong hanciamkhawm un.
Judea gam thu-umlo mite' khut pan ka suahtak nading leh Jerusalem khua' ading ka nasepna mi siangthote' mai-ah a santaak a suah ding ka deih hi.
Tua hileh Pasian' deihna bangin note' kiangah nuamna tawh hong pai thei-in nong kikholhpihna uh tawh ka tha hong malh ding hi.
Nopna lemna Pasian in note hong ompih ta hen. Amen.
